meta.title: RestoLink — Menus, reinvented
meta.description: RestoLink turns a QR code into a fast, always up-to-date digital menu that guests open straight in their browser.

hero.title: Menus, reinvented.
hero.subtitle: Your guest scans a code and the menu is already open. You change a price and it is live everywhere in seconds.
hero.visualLabel: The same RestoLink menu on a phone, a computer and a second phone — in Polish, English and German, in a light and a dark theme.

experience.title: Three seconds from table to menu.
experience.subtitle: No app store, no waiting for a printed card — just a browser your guest already has open.

step1.title: Spots the QR code
step1.body: On the table, by the door or at the bar — wherever guests already look. A stand, a sticker or a coaster: all it takes is a code in plain sight.

step2.title: Scans the QR code
step2.body: The camera is enough. The menu opens in the browser, with no app to install and nothing to sign up for.

step3.title: Browses and filters
step3.body: Photos, descriptions and allergens in one place. Whoever avoids gluten hides everything containing it with a single tap.

mock.filterHint: Select the allergens whose dishes should be hidden from the menu.
mock.salmonLong: A juicy salmon fillet grilled skin-side down, served with a silky lemon butter sauce, roasted seasonal vegetables and fresh dill. Light, yet filling.
mock.salmonIngredients: salmon, butter, lemon, dill, courgette, pepper, carrot

features.title: Everything under control.
features.subtitle: From the first dish to a QR code on the table, in three steps.

b1.title: Menu builder
b1.body: Add categories and dishes with a photo, description, price and allergens. Drag to change the order, and hide a sold-out dish with one switch.

b2.title: Menu design
b2.body: Pick a ready-made theme or your own colours, typeface and logo. The preview beside it shows the menu the way a guest will see it, and text colour adapts to the background by itself, so the menu always stays readable.

b3.title: QR code
b3.body: Match the code to your venue: module shape, a colour or gradient, and your logo in the middle. Download it as PNG, or as SVG that stays sharp at any size — from a sticker to a poster.
b3.point1: Your own shapes, colours and logo

pricing.title: Simple and predictable.
pricing.subtitle: One rate, every feature and no setup fee.

footer.tagline: Digital menus for restaurants, cafés and bars. A QR code instead of a printed card.
